assistants.name: Word Creator

description_i18n.en-US: Create, edit, and analyze professional Word documents with officecli. Reports, proposals, letters, memos, and more.

prompts: Create a 10-slide Kubernetes migration proposal with architecture comparison, cost analysis, and migration timeline
